SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Diversity and interpersonal relationships is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Diversity and interpersonal relationships with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Diversity and interpersonal relationships.
   C. Say Diversity and interpersonal relationships never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Diversity and interpersonal relationships as rumours only.

2. Which statement about Developments in Medium of trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Developments in Medium of trade never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Developments in Medium of trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Developments in Medium of trade.
   D. Treat Developments in Medium of trade as rumours only.

3. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Ignore prices in shops

   C. Say Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6.

5. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Replace the compass rose

6. Which statement about Slavery and Servitude is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Slavery and Servitude with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   C. Say Slavery and Servitude never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Slavery and Servitude as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Historical Development of Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Historical Development of Agriculture.
   B. Explain Historical Development of Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Historical Development of Agriculture as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Maps and map work is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Maps and map work with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Maps and map work as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Maps and map work.

9. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

10. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Kisumu

11. Which statement about Peaceful Coexistence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Peaceful Coexistence as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Peaceful Coexistence.
   C. Say Peaceful Coexistence never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Peaceful Coexistence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
